plan_review.notes: Alternative A: planner-integrated spell purchase bundle, adopted after review because it prevents a failed broker attempt from silently suppressing merchant purchases. Alternative B: effect-returned cast success, rejected for now because the existing activation contract treats a completed gated activation as spell use; targetless behavior remains a future mechanics refinement. Review also identified missing browser modal handling and stale state mutation; the stale mutation was removed and planner/resolver goal wiring plus regression tests were added.

findings.detail: spellBrokerPurchase defaults to true in DEFAULT_CONFIG while the analogous merchantWeaponPurchase defaults to false. With it on, ~25% of seeds now insert a farm+buy broker detour post-spellbook, which can silently shift existing headless AI win-rate/pacing baselines. Confirm this baseline change is intended (or default it false like the merchant flag) so benchmark diffs are attributable.

independent_grade.notes: Cohesive, well-tested feature: seeded broker offers, per-spell usage-skill efficacy applied centrally in progressionEffects, AI intent mirroring the merchant pattern, goal-graph/route integration, UI modal, and labs. Typecheck passes, 3 new test suites pass, CI dead-code lint clean. Determinism preserved via a dedicated RNG stream; efficacy is a no-op at level 0 so no regression to existing spell output. ADR + review ledger included. No blockers or high-confidence bugs found; only a minor default-on baseline-impact note.
